g.text: pi-nobash: core, stack docs, and companions
Three developer levers (how capability is chosen)
Effective model-facing toolset — per agent = the union of what was selected for that session
a `bash` call → BLOCKED — it never reaches a shell
no tool for the request → CAPABILITY_GAP — no shell, interpreter, or generic runner
typescript.md — Node / web and React Native (Expo)
1. Select tools — Pi native: --tools / defaultTools / SDK tools
Pi native tools — not shipped by pi-nobash
companions (opt-in source; you write and select them)
7 packaged tools: git_status · git_diff · git_log · git_show · json_query · query_jsonl · run_validation
read · grep · find · ls · edit · write
the recipe tells you what to select, configure, and load
the selected union becomes the agent's toolset
bash is blocked at the call boundary
the request has no matching tool
